शट् {vI.v} {c1c} P. (शटति)
1 To be sick.
--2 To divide, separate.
--3 To be
dissolved.
--4 To be weary or
dejected.
--5 To go. {vII.v} {c10c} A.
(शाटयते) To praise, flatter.
षाट् ind. A vocative particle.

सट् {vI.v} {c1c} P. (सटति) To form a
part. {vII.v} {c10c} U. (साटयति-ते) To
show, display, manifest.

सट्ट् {c10c} U. (सट्टयति-ते)
1 To
injure, kill,
--2 To be strong.
--3 To
give.
--4 To take.
--5 To dwell.

साट् {c10c} U. (साटयति-ते) To show,
manifest.
शट a. Sour, acid, astringent.

शटा The matted hair of an
ascetic; cf. जटा, सिंहकेशर.

सटं, सटा
1 An ascetic's matted
hair.
--2 The mane (of a lion);

; Śi. 1. 47.
--3 Bristles of a
boar; विध्यंतमुद्धृतसटाः प्रतिहंतुमीषुः

.
--4 A braid of hair.
--5 A
crest.
--Comp.
--अंकः a lion.
शटिः f. The plant called Zedoary.
सटिः --टी f., सटिका Zedoary.

शट्टकं Flour of rice mixed with
water and ghee.

शाटकः --कं Cloth, garment,
petticoat;

सट्टकं A kind of minor drama in
Prākṛta; e. g. कर्पूरमंजरी; see
S.

शाटः, शाटी
1 A garment, cloth.
--2 A petticoat.

शाटः, शाटी
1 A garment, cloth.
--2 A petticoat.
सटिः --टी f., सटिका Zedoary.

शाटकः --कं Cloth, garment,
petticoat;

शाट्यायनं An oblation for
remedying anything wrong in the
performance of a rite.

षट्क a. Sixfold.
--कं An
aggregate of six; मासषट्क, पूर्वषट्क,
उत्तरषट्क &c.

षाट्कौशिक a. (की f.) Incased
or enveloped in six sheaths.

षाट्पौरुषिक a. (की f.)
Belonging to six generations (पुरुष).

सटं, सटा
1 An ascetic's matted
hair.
--2 The mane (of a lion);

; Śi. 1. 47.
--3 Bristles of a
boar; विध्यंतमुद्धृतसटाः प्रतिहंतुमीषुः

.
--4 A braid of hair.
--5 A
crest.
--Comp.
--अंकः a lion.

सटीक a. Accompanied or
explained by a commentary.

1 A kind of bird.
--2 A
musical instrument.

साटोप a.
1 Elated or puffed up
with pride, haughty.
--2 Majestic,
stately.
--3 Swollen, filled or
charged with, (as with water);
Pt. 1

.
--पं ind. Proudly,
arrogantly, in a stately manner, struttingly;
as in साटोपं परिक्रामति.
